concepts.def: Membrane is a phospholipid bilayer with embedded proteins that move laterally; cholesterol stabilises it.
Net movement of particles down a concentration gradient; passive, no ATP.
Passive transport of polar/large molecules through channel or carrier proteins down a gradient.
Net movement of water from higher to lower water potential across a partially permeable membrane.
Movement of substances against a gradient by carrier proteins using ATP.
Coupled movement of one substance with another (e.g. Na⁺ with glucose) using a carrier protein.
